# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.0-alpha.1-internal.1897 (loopback protocol check)
name: "OpenAI Decisions support routing"
version: "1.0"
agents: []
orchestrator:
  name: decision
  strategy: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: classify
        type: decision
        decision:
          backend: openai
          input: {from: query}
          questions:
            queue:
              type: choice
              instructions: "Which queue should own this report?"
              choices:
                billing: "Payments, refunds or invoices"
                technical: "Errors, outages or broken functionality"
